offers_products.reason: Sells SaaS, POS, CRM and eCommerce software to cannabis retailers and brands; software counts as product.

offers_services.reason: Sells advertising and listings on the Weedmaps marketplace, plus delivery solutions, to dispensaries and brands.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumers use the Weedmaps marketplace free; paying buyers are cannabis retailers, brands and advertisers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Dispensaries, brands and advertisers buy subscriptions, ads and SaaS tools.

recurring_revenue.reason: Dispensaries and brands pay monthly subscriptions for listings, ads and SaaS software.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertising spend by cannabis retailers and brands is easily cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Small monthly subscriptions and ad purchases, frequent and low-value per buyer.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from software platform and marketplace traffic, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly small and mid-size licensed dispensaries and cannabis brands.

asset_heavy.reason: Online marketplace and SaaS business needing software development, not plants or fleets.
